description: This file defines the CsvDataImportFactory class responsible for creating instances of CSV data importers based on the specified import type, specifically for PIM data in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: CsvDataImportFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides instances of CSV data import classes based on the specified import type.

methods.name: getImportClassInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of PimCsvDataImport if the import type is 'pim'.
